presets.title: Unity games (DirectX 11)
presets.notes: General starting point for Unity games. Most of them use DirectX 11, which runs best through DXVK. If the game stays black or crashes on start, try WineD3D.

presets.title: Unreal games (DirectX 11)
presets.notes: Unreal games often install their own Windows components, so they get a bottle of their own. Games with anti-cheat usually won't run.

presets.title: GameMaker games
presets.notes: GameMaker Studio 2 games use DirectX 11 and run well through DXVK. Older GameMaker games may work better with WineD3D.

presets.title: Ren'Py games
presets.notes: Many Ren'Py games also come with a Mac version; check the download page first. Otherwise this runs the Windows version.

presets.title: RPG Maker VX Ace games
presets.notes: Runs through Wine. If the game asks for the RPG Maker VX Ace RTP, install it into the game's bottle; most releases already include what they need.
